name: Sato Corporation
summary: Sato Corporation engages in providing automatic identification solution products in Japan and internationally. It offers printers, consumables, hand labelers, primary labels, label printing tools, labels, magnetic card, IC tags, ribbons, tickets, ink, and maintenance services. The company also provides software solutions for printing and management of label/tag data; and technical servicing support.
